name: meeting-transcribe-agent
description: Universal meeting intelligence and interactive verbatim transcription suite. Features native Multimodal Video Pipeline (YouTube URLs & local video files), Dual-Pass Google Cloud Speech-to-Text v2 Chirp 3 (chirp_3) acoustic diarization and word-timestamp alignment, local Apple Silicon MLX/Whisper + Sherpa-ONNX diarization, Gemini 3.8 Flash minutes structuring and semantic paragraph segmentation, canonical speaker consolidation, and standalone zero-dependency interactive HTML playback player.
